text.p: First Union Corp's First Union Capital Markets Corp and Merrill Lynch & Co Inc said they completed a $1.138 billion offering of securities backed by multi-family and commercial mortgages.
The companies said it was the industry's largest commercial mortgage conduit securitization.

The transaction consists of 300 commercial mortgage loans. Multifamily properties made up 44.2 percent of the pool balance, retail accounted for 25.3 percent, hotel for 10.3 percent, office for 7.2 percent and 13 percent was listed as "other."

The companies said the properties are located in 36 states. Among the larger geographic concentrations, 14.7 percent are located in Texas, 12.7 percent are located in California and 11.5 percent are in Florida.

First Union's Commercial Real Estate Finance Group originated or acquired 158 of the loans. First Union Commercial Mortgage Servicing, a unit of First Union National Bank of North Carolina, will be the master servicer of the transaction.
